issue.title: Adコラムを終了し、ヘルプページへ置き換える

summary: Replace the Ad column navigation and route with a practical Help surface backed by the Issue #17 content contract.
decisions: Issue #16 supersedes the current Ad column requirement in REQUIREMENTS.md and DESIGN.md.
Preserve useful support content through redirects or mapping; do not leave dead links.
Help prioritizes operational answers, search/browse clarity, and explicit CMS states.
requirementRefs: DESIGN.md#2-アプリケーション構成

risks.description: Existing Ad column links or bookmarks may break.
risks.mitigation: Inventory and redirect/replace internal links; browser-test the legacy route.

risks.description: CMS outage or no content may produce a blank surface.
risks.mitigation: Ship explicit fallback and retry guidance without fabricating content.

gates.description: The issue is accepted as the new source of truth for this navigation slot.

acceptanceCriteria: Primary navigation and page title use Help instead of Ad column.
Help index/detail states are accessible and responsive.
Legacy route/internal links are redirected or intentionally retired without a dead end.
CMS loading, empty, error, retry, and fallback behavior is explicit.
REQUIREMENTS.md and DESIGN.md no longer require Ad column.

rollback.strategy: Restore the prior navigation route behind a local code rollback while preserving CMS content and identifiers.
rollback.verification: Navigation contains no duplicate entry and every previously published internal link resolves intentionally.
